chapter: Riverside and the New York scene
title: The bass Oscar Pettiford gave him
summary: Art Blakey tries to buy him a bass but Pettiford offers him an old German flatback, and the fiddle is often pawned.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Because Art took me down to the music store to buy me one.
You mean he had those intentions?

Sure. He took me down and said, 'pick you out one' -- I didn't want him to buy this fiddle that he picked out, because I wanted a fiddle that was already broken in, you might say -- you know, I thought, tell him, let's go to a pawn shop, but he didn't have that kind of cash money to put out in front, you know but that was when ... Pettiford offered he bought this fiddle for me, you know, a beautiful instrument.
What kind of instrument was it?
